Definition: a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate:--henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time). See also G3569, G3570.
BiblicalUsage: Nun is simply the word for now, this time, the present moment, the turning point. In Matthew 24:21 it marks the great tribulation to come, and in Mark 10:30 it marks the hundredfold received now in this time, with persecutions.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe now is where God meets us, and the present is never empty when He is in it.
